title: Edge Node Schema
description: Base schema for all edge types in the IGVF Catalog. Defines common required properties.

_from.description: Document handle of the source node, in collection/key form.

_to.description: Document handle of the target node, in collection/key form.

label.description: The specific assay or relationship this edge represents, phrased for display. Predicted edges carry a 'predicted' prefix.

class.description: Evidence tier for the edge: 'observed data' for a direct experimental measurement, 'prediction' for the output of a computational model, and 'biological relationship' for a curated relationship drawn from an ontology or pathway database.

method.description: The assay, algorithm, or pipeline that generated the edge.

name.description: Predicate describing the relationship in the _from to _to direction.

inverse_name.description: Predicate describing the same relationship in the _to to _from direction. Identical to name for symmetric relationships.

source.description: The dataset or consortium this edge was loaded from.

source_url.description: Link to the specific upstream record or file this edge was derived from.
